description: Threat coverage and actionable remediation on realistic vulnerable surfaces.

cases.task: Run a security audit on this API surface and explain exploit paths

context.description: REST API with IDOR and SQLi patterns in diff

candidates.output: Threat coverage: broken object-level auth on `/user/{id}` enables IDOR; SQL injection in legacy search param. Exploit path: swap user id then chain to admin token. Remediation: enforce object ownership checks, parameterize queries, rotate API keys after fix.
No major issues found. Enable HTTPS.

cases.task: Review repo scan: leaked AWS keys in history — what to do?

context.description: Gitleaks found AKIA keys in commit from 2024

expectedBehavior.summary: Revoke keys, rotate, purge history guidance

candidates.output: Immediately revoke and rotate the exposed AKIA keys in IAM. Audit CloudTrail for use. Remove from git history or accept key rotation as source of truth. Prevent: store secrets in a vault/secret manager; add pre-commit gitleaks.
Delete the file and commit again.

cases.task: Assess SSRF risk in user-supplied URL fetch feature

context.description: Server fetches arbitrary URLs for link previews

expectedBehavior.summary: SSRF to metadata IP; allowlist/denylist mitigations

candidates.output: SSRF: attackers can hit `http://169.254.169.254/` or internal admin ports. Mitigation: allowlist schemes/hosts, block link-local and RFC1918, no redirects to internal IPs, egress proxy with policy.
Fetching URLs is safe if you use HTTPS.
